ar: يحتفل الناس حول العالم بالمناسبات الخاصة باستخدام الطعام.
en: People around the world celebrate special events with food.
questions: How do people celebrate special events?
Do people use food in celebrations?

ar: يستمتعون بالطعام الخاص في الأعراس والأعياد وأعياد الميلاد.
en: People enjoy special food at weddings, on holidays, and on birthdays.
questions: What occasions include special food?
Is food part of birthdays?

ar: بعض الناس يحتفلون بالمهرجانات الغذائية التي تحدث مرة في السنة.
en: Some people also celebrate food with festivals that happen once a year.
questions: How often do food festivals happen?
Are festivals frequent or yearly?

ar: مهرجان الثوم في جيلروي بولاية كاليفورنيا حدث كبير جداً في شهر يوليو.
en: The Gilroy Garlic Festival in California is a very big event in July.
questions: Where is the garlic festival?
When does it happen?

ar: يتم تحضير أطباق كثيرة باستخدام الثوم مثل الفشار والآيس كريم.
en: Many dishes are made with garlic, including popcorn and ice cream.
questions: What food is special in Gilroy festival?
Can garlic be used in desserts?

ar: مهرجان الكمأة الأبيض الدولي في إيطاليا يقام في أكتوبر.
en: The International White Truffle Fair in Italy takes place in October.
questions: Where is the truffle festival?
When is it held?

ar: الكمأ طعام غالي جداً ويؤكل مع المعكرونة أو الأرز.
en: Truffles are very expensive and eaten with pasta or rice.
questions: Is truffle food cheap or expensive?
What is it eaten with?

ar: مهرجان الرنجة في فنلندا قديم جداً ويحتفل بالسمك.
en: The Baltic Herring Festival in Finland is very old and celebrates fish.
questions: What does the Finnish festival celebrate?
Is it a new or old festival?

ar: في السعودية، يحتفل الناس بأكل الكوزي وهو لحم مطبوخ.
en: In Saudi Arabia, people celebrate by eating kuzi, cooked lamb.
questions: What is kuzi?
Is it eaten in Saudi Arabia?

ar: في عيد الفطر، يستمتع الناس بأطباق لذيذة ويتشاركون الطعام مع الآخرين.
en: During Eid, people enjoy delicious food and share meals with others.
questions: What do people do during Eid?
Do people share food?
